scripts.lint: node scripts/python.mjs -m ruff check apps/api scripts && npm run lint --workspace apps/web
scripts.format: prettier --write apps/web scripts/*.mjs tests playwright.config.ts *.json docs/*.md README.md DEMO_SCRIPT.md && node scripts/python.mjs -m ruff format apps/api scripts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps/web scripts/*.mjs tests playwright.config.ts *.json docs/*.md README.md DEMO_SCRIPT.md && node scripts/python.mjs -m ruff format --check apps/api scripts
